systems.system: Outils numériques dédiés aux nouvelles collectivités territoriales
systems.country_label: outils numériques de gestion pour les collectivités locales
systems.owner: government (national development plan, Ministry of Finance, Budget, Economy and Plan)
systems.tiers: provincial and communal councils; planned, to simplify and harmonise local administrative procedures, listed among the plan's first results
national; launched 2022, e-invoicing launched 2024 and generalised 2025

note: The national plan of 2025-08-27 plans digital management tools for the collectivités territoriales, an application, and says nothing of connecting their offices. It gives the country's own count: 23 autonomous provincial councils and 125 communes.
